# WELCOME TO THE **BRIDGING TRANSPORTATION RESEARCHERS** (BTR) ONLINE CONFERENCE!

At zero cost, and practically zero carbon, BTR brings transportation engineers, planners, & policymakers together globally by removing the burden of travel, the cost of registration, & emissions associated with transport & accommodations – EVERY YEAR.

We look forward to seeing you, your colleagues, students, sponsors, & other transport enthusiasts on

**Wednesday + Thursday August 6 & 7, 2025!**

[Register here – it's FREE!](#register){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}

[View PROGRAM here!](#program){.btn .btn-secondary .btn-lg}
:::

*[Headliner information will be updated as speakers are confirmed]*

## Conference Information

We solicit paper submissions from January through March each year (via past registrants & co-sponsoring organizations) and welcome transport researchers and practitioners from diverse disciplines, particularly individuals who are unable to obtain a visa or afford traveling to and participating in international conferences.

Since its inception in 2018, BTR is now in its seventh year, taking place on **AUGUST 6 & 7, 2025 – in both hemispheres** (so everyone can be wide awake for at least half the events).

**Any further questions? Please see [what to expect at BTR](what-to-expect.qmd).**

## Thank you to our Sponsors:

In collaboration with the journal [npj Sustainable Mobility and Transport](https://www.nature.com/npjsustmob/), **Best Paper Award in Sustainable Transport** will be conferred at the upcoming **BTR7**. This award celebrates scholarly excellence and provides an opportunity for broader dissemination of impactful research. Details are available in the [BTR blog](blog.qmd) or the [LinkedIn post](https://www.linkedin.com/company/bridging-transportation-researchers/).

## Important Dates {#schedule}

- **January 24, 2025** – call for paper submissions
- **April 30, 2025** – paper submissions due
- **May-June** – peer review process
- **July** – conference schedule and keynote speakers finalized
- **August 6-7, 2025** – BTR Conference

## Registration {#register}

Registration for BTR 7 is completely free and open to all transportation researchers, practitioners, and enthusiasts worldwide. Simply visit our registration page to secure your spot for this year's conference.

## Program {#program}

The detailed program for BTR 7 will be available in July 2025. The conference features:

- **Renowned headliners** from leading institutions worldwide
- **Parallel sessions** across multiple tracks
- **Interactive presentations** with Q&A opportunities
- **Networking opportunities** through virtual breakout rooms
- **Recorded sessions** available after the conference
